name: Astro Editor
description: CodeMirror 6 editor for astro fields. Holds the source of a whole .astro file (frontmatter, markup and {expressions}) verbatim so the website build can write it to a real page and let Astro compile it.
author: Sci-Fi CMS Team

theme.label: Editor Theme
theme.description: Visual theme for the editor. 'auto' follows the admin dark mode.

tabSize.label: Tab Size
tabSize.description: Number of spaces used for indentation (and Tab-to-indent)

defaultTemplate.label: Default Template
defaultTemplate.description: Astro source inserted into a new, empty astro field. Leave empty to use the built-in starter template (frontmatter plus a Layout wrapper).
